mapeh-t2w8-go-foods.alt: Steamed rice, pandesal, kamote, cassava and boiled saba banana arranged on a pale surface
mapeh-t2w8-go-foods.source: A flat-lay of Filipino GO foods, the energy group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a white bowl of steamed rice, a basket of pandesal rolls, a whole purple-skinned kamote with two slices cut to show the orange flesh, a length of cassava root, and a few pieces of boiled saba banana.

mapeh-t2w8-glow-foods.alt: Kangkong, halved papaya, mangoes, ampalaya, pechay and calamansi arranged on a pale surface
mapeh-t2w8-glow-foods.source: A flat-lay of Filipino GLOW foods, the vitamins and minerals group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a bundle of kangkong water spinach, a halved ripe papaya showing orange flesh and black seeds, two ripe mangoes, a bitter gourd ampalaya, a bunch of pechay, and several calamansi limes.

mapeh-t2w8-grow-foods.alt: A whole bangus, boiled eggs, monggo beans, chicken, tofu and a glass of milk arranged on a pale surface
mapeh-t2w8-grow-foods.source: A flat-lay of Filipino GROW foods, the body-building group, arranged on a pale neutral surface: a whole raw bangus milkfish, two boiled eggs with one cut in half, a small bowl of dried monggo beans, a piece of raw chicken, a block of tofu, and a glass of milk.

mapeh-t2w2-gongs.alt: Eight graded bronze gongs on a carved wooden frame with two padded beaters, and a larger flat gong behind
mapeh-t2w2-gongs.source: Close view of a row of eight small bronze gongs of graded size resting on a carved wooden frame, with two padded wooden beater sticks laid across them, and one larger flat bronze gong propped behind. Warm indoor daylight, pale background.

mapeh-t2w3-formats.alt: A vinyl record, a cassette tape, a compact disc and a smartphone with earphones laid out in a row
mapeh-t2w3-formats.source: A flat-lay showing how recorded music has been stored, left to right on a pale neutral surface: a black vinyl record, a cassette tape, a compact disc catching a faint rainbow sheen, and a modern smartphone lying face down with white earphones coiled beside it.

mapeh-t2w4-art-tools.alt: Raw ochre pigment and a stone tool, a bristle brush with oil paints, and a stylus on a graphics tablet
mapeh-t2w4-art-tools.source: A flat-lay of art-making tools from different eras on a pale neutral surface, left to right: a lump of raw red ochre pigment beside a rough stone hand tool, a wooden-handled bristle brush beside two squeezed tubes of oil paint, and a slim black stylus resting on the corner of a graphics tablet.

mapeh-t2w1-instruments.alt: Kulintang gongs, a flat gangsa gong, a two-string boat lute, a bamboo jaw harp, a bamboo flute and a skin-headed hand drum
mapeh-t2w1-instruments.source: A flat-lay of traditional Filipino musical instruments on a pale neutral surface: a row of small bronze kulintang gongs on a wooden frame, a flat bronze gangsa gong, a carved two-string wooden boat lute, a small bamboo jaw harp, a bamboo nose flute, and a goblet-shaped hand drum with a stretched skin head.

mapeh-t2w6-panels.alt: An open sketchbook ruled into four empty comic panels with a pencil and eraser beside it
mapeh-t2w6-panels.source: An open sketchbook on a wooden desk, the right-hand page ruled by hand into four empty rectangular comic panels with clean white gutters between them. A mechanical pencil and a kneaded eraser rest beside it. The panels are completely blank. Overhead daylight.

mapeh-t2w5-symbols.alt: Handwoven red, black and cream abaca cloth, a star-shaped capiz lantern, a carved leaf-and-vine wood panel and a small carved wooden figure
mapeh-t2w5-symbols.source: A flat-lay of Filipino craft objects on a pale neutral surface: a folded length of handwoven abaca cloth in deep red, black and cream with geometric patterning, a star-shaped capiz-shell lantern, a panel of dark hardwood carved with flowing leaf-and-vine scrollwork, and a small carved standing wooden figure.

mapeh-t2w7-games.alt: A rubber slipper, a tin can, a woven rattan ball, chalk, glass marbles and a carved sungka board with shells
mapeh-t2w7-games.source: A flat-lay of the everyday objects Filipino street games are played with, on worn pale concrete: a single rubber tsinelas slipper, an empty tin can lying on its side, a woven rattan sipa ball, a stick of white chalk, a handful of small glass marbles, and a long carved wooden sungka board with cowrie shells in its hollows.

mapeh-t2w10-planning.alt: Blank index cards laid out in a row with a pencil, headphones and a phone on a small tripod
mapeh-t2w10-planning.source: A flat-lay of a video project being planned on a wooden desk: a row of blank white index cards laid out in sequence, a pencil, a pair of over-ear headphones, and a smartphone resting on a small desktop tripod. The cards are completely blank.

mapeh-t2w9-fitness-tests.alt: A wooden sit-and-reach box, a stopwatch, a skipping rope, a tape measure and worn training shoes on a gym floor
mapeh-t2w9-fitness-tests.source: A flat-lay of school fitness-testing equipment on a gymnasium floor: a wooden sit-and-reach box with a measuring scale along the top, a stopwatch, a coiled skipping rope, a retractable tape measure, and a pair of worn training shoes.

mapeh-t2w11-expo.alt: A cloth-covered exhibition table holding a woven basket, a capiz lantern, two bronze gongs and a tablet on a stand
mapeh-t2w11-expo.source: A simple school exhibition table seen from a visitor's side: a folding table covered with a plain cloth, holding a small handwoven basket, a star-shaped capiz lantern, a pair of bronze gongs and a tablet propped on a stand with a blank dark screen. Bright hall daylight, no people, no signage.
